title: Greenfield Structural Decisions

claim_stubs.name: ISO 9241-110 Suitability for the Task
claim_stubs.engineering_meaning: Show only controls/info needed for the current task; minimize steps for common paths; hide advanced options until needed.
claim_stubs.how_to_detect_violations: For a screen, mark elements not supporting the primary task; if a large share is irrelevant, fail.
claim_stubs.when_to_apply: Task-focused flows: forms, checkout, setup wizards.
claim_stubs.when_not_to_apply: Command centers / multi-goal dashboards where breadth is the task.

claim_stubs.name: Hick-Hyman Law
claim_stubs.engineering_meaning: Reduce simultaneous actionable choices; chunk into hierarchies/search; highlight a primary action so effective n is small for novices.
claim_stubs.how_to_detect_violations: Count peer primary actions in a decision region; many equally weighted CTAs/menu items without grouping (often ≫7 visible peers) → overload risk.
claim_stubs.when_to_apply: Nav menus, pricing tiers, settings panels, checkout decisions, onboarding choices.
claim_stubs.when_not_to_apply: Expert analytic dashboards needing simultaneous density; highly learned expert UIs.

claim_stubs.name: Fitts's Law (Shannon Formulation)
claim_stubs.engineering_meaning: Reduce pointing latency by increasing effective target width and decreasing travel distance for frequent actions. Treat screen edges as larger effective targets.
claim_stubs.how_to_detect_violations: Estimate A from resting cursor/thumb zones and W of primary CTAs; flag frequent actions with high ID or targets below WCAG floor.
claim_stubs.when_to_apply: CTA placement, toolbars, menus, drag targets on pointer UIs.
claim_stubs.when_not_to_apply: Pure keyboard flows; voice; intentionally high-friction destructive controls.

claim_stubs.name: WCAG 2.2 Target Size (Minimum)
claim_stubs.engineering_meaning: Interactive hit areas must meet ≥24×24 CSS px, or ensure undersized targets have enough clearance that 24px-diameter circles centered on their boxes do not intersect other targets.
claim_stubs.how_to_detect_violations: Measure CSS bounding boxes. If width or height < 24px, test whether a 24px-diameter circle centered on the box intersects any other target.
claim_stubs.when_to_apply: All pointer-activated controls (mouse, touch, pen), including icon-only buttons.
claim_stubs.when_not_to_apply: Inline text links constrained by line-height; unmodified user-agent controls; equivalent larger control available; essential/legal presentation exceptions per WCAG.

claim_stubs.name: WCAG Contrast (Minimum)
claim_stubs.engineering_meaning: Compute relative luminance of foreground/background pairs. Fail if normal text < 4.5:1 or large text (≈18pt+/14pt bold) < 3:1. Prefer semantic tokens that encode compliant pairs.
claim_stubs.how_to_detect_violations: Automated contrast checkers (axe, WAVE, WebAIM) plus sampling computed styles on text over images/gradients.
claim_stubs.when_to_apply: All meaningful text and images of text, including form labels and error copy.
claim_stubs.when_not_to_apply: Decorative text, inactive/disabled components, incidental logotypes as allowed by WCAG.

claim_stubs.name: Fogg Behavior Model (B=MAP)
claim_stubs.engineering_meaning: Diagnose failed CTAs/onboarding by testing Prompt visibility/timing, Ability (friction), and Motivation (value clarity). Prefer raising Ability before spamming prompts.
claim_stubs.how_to_detect_violations: High exposure + low conversion: check if prompt is hidden, task is hard, or value is unclear.
claim_stubs.when_to_apply: Conversion CTAs, onboarding, notifications, habit loops.
claim_stubs.when_not_to_apply: Passive reading surfaces; automated backend processes; manipulative dark patterns.

claim_stubs.name: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
claim_stubs.engineering_meaning: Sticky headers/footers, cookie bars, and overlays must not fully cover the focused control. Use scroll-margin / focus management so focused nodes stay at least partially visible.
claim_stubs.how_to_detect_violations: Tab through the page with sticky chrome present; fail if focused element is completely covered.
claim_stubs.when_to_apply: All interactive components, especially with sticky UI chrome.
claim_stubs.when_not_to_apply: User-opened content (e.g., modal) dismissible without advancing focus, per WCAG nuance.

conflict_pairs.decision_hint: Prioritize WCAG mins, one primary CTA, then chunk choices.
